description.value: Hangar 31 Café is a community café in Comox whose name and identity nod to the Comox Valley's Airforce heritage. Its specialty coffee comes exclusively from Rhodos Coffee & Bistro, a sister roastery that has been hand-selecting and small-batch roasting beans since 1993. The menu spans espresso drinks, cold brew, chai, pastries, and grab-and-go items, making it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the valley.
